title: primula magellanica subsp. decipiens
intro: Primula magellanica subsp. decipiens, commonly known as the "Mountain Primrose", is a flowering plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. It is native to the Andes mountain range in South America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Primula magellanica subsp. decipiens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
